ابتعدوا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَعَدُوا (ibtaʕadū) /ib.ta.ʕa.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِبْتَعَدَ (ibtaʕada)
# اِبْتَعِدُوا (ibtaʕidū) /ib.ta.ʕi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِبْتَعَدَ (ibtaʕada)
